remarks: Beautifully appointed 2BR, 3BA condo offers 1,428 SF of low-maintenance living with 9' ceilings in the desirable Cos Cob neighborhood of Greenwich, CT. The gourmet kitchen features abundant cabinetry, high-end stainless appliances, stone countertops, breakfast bar, and built-in desk. The expansive open-concept living room has room to dine and a freestanding gas stove nestled in the corner. A versatile lower-level family room provides space for relaxing, entertaining, or a home office. Both bedrooms are ensuite with custom closets, while 2nd-floor laundry adds convenience. Ideally located less than 5 minutes from Cos Cob's shops, restaurants, waterfront, parks, schools and Metro-North train station, this exceptional condo combines comfort, convenience, and the best of the Cos Cob lifestyle.
